name: io.github.chrischall/jobber-mcp
description: Read the Jobber Client Hub your service providers share: appointments, invoices and quotes

environmentVariables.name: JOBBER_HUB_ID
environmentVariables.description: Single hub UUID, from your hub URL: clienthub.getjobber.com/client_hubs/<UUID>/. Treat it like a password.

environmentVariables.name: JOBBER_HUBS
environmentVariables.description: JSON array of {label, hubId} for several providers. Labels must be unique ignoring case (including the JOBBER_HUB_ID hub's label). Treat it like a password.

environmentVariables.name: JOBBER_WS_PORT
environmentVariables.description: fetchproxy concentrator port (default 37149 — don't change it).

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bind interface for the fetchproxy concentrator (default 127.0.0.1; a literal IP only). For a hosted child in its own network namespace only — never bind a laptop's concentrator to the network.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_IDENTITY_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path where fetchproxy stores its long-term identity keypair (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/). For a host that runs a separate child per caller, so they share one identity.
